text:
SSL::sni
Description
prior to version 11.6
Returns the “Server Name” attribute of the SSL profile currently
selected. If the profile does not have this property set, the CN of
the associated certificate is returned.
in version 11.6 and later
Returns the “Server Name” attribute of the SSL profile currently
selected. If the profile does not have this property set, empty(null)
value is returned.
Syntax
SSL
::
sni
name
SSL
::
sni
required
SSL::sni name
Returns the current Server Name Indication.
SSL::sni required
Returns the require SNI support.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.info
"SNI name: [SSL::sni name]"
log
local0.info
"SNI required: [SSL::sni required]"
}
